name: auriga-pr-guards
description: Workflow guardrails for `gh pr create` and `gh pr ready` — inject PR body snapshots and block PR-Ready on structural issues (stray planning docs, unfinalized specs, unpushed commits).

interface.longDescription: Two hooks that fire when the agent runs `gh pr create` or `gh pr ready`. The create-side injects a body snapshot (headings + TODO counts) so the agent can self-verify scope/acceptance/risks/TODO. The ready-side blocks on structural problems (stray planning docs, unfinalized active specs in docs/specs/, unpushed commits) and otherwise injects the body snapshot. Designed for the auriga workflow in https://github.com/Ben2pc/auriga-cli.
